notes.title: Update 0.1.7
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing Station Master RPG![/p][p]I'm back from holiday and will now continue working on the game. Here's what's new in this update:[/p][list][*][p]Removed "X passengers missed their train" messages and their negative service rating effect altogether, as this has caused more confusion than it was actually a good game feature[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level-up not working after reaching later in-game years[/p][/*][*][p]The slide is now quicker, so passengers will not queue up that much anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed NPCs not finding their way after using a vending machine placed on the grass next to a sidewalk[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected staff position when ckecking tickets at entrance-only or exit-only gates[/p][/*][/list][p]That's it for this update![/p][p]If you stumble across any problem with the game, make sure to report it in the Steam Community section![/p][p]Thanks to all of you for playing this game! I really appreciate it![/p][p]~ Shioyama[/p]

tags.bug: Fixed level-up not working after reaching later in-game years
Fixed NPCs not finding their way after using a vending machine placed on the grass next to a sidewalk
Corrected staff position when ckecking tickets at entrance-only or exit-only gates

notes.title: Update 0.1.6
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing Station Master RPG![/p][p]This update finally addresses the performance issues with passengers (among other things) through the following measures:[/p][list][*][p]Optimised passenger spawning mechanism[/p][list][*][p]Note that passenger numbers may now be different from how they were before this update[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Implemented a pathfinding cache that makes NPCs much more efficient[/p][/*][*][p]Made NPC behaviour more efficient in general[/p][/*][*][p]Trains now depart forcedly after a maximum delay of 25 minutes after scheduled departure time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed passengers not finding their way across staircases in some cases[/p][/*][/list][p]Something else to consider: Due to a bug, passengers may currently not find their way across a staircase if the staircase was built first and the upper floor added to it afterwards. So, make sure to place the floor first and then add the stairs.[/p][p]That's it for this update![/p][p]If you stumble across any problem with the game, make sure to report it in the Steam Community section![/p][p]Thanks to all of you for playing this game! I really appreciate it![/p][p]~ Shioyama[/p]

I really appreciate it![/p][p]~ Shioyama[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.content:
Thanks to those who submitted feedback and bug reports! I'm gradually working through each one of them.

This update addresses the following issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed passengers going up and down staircases endlessly
[*] Stuck passengers will now go home after a certain amount of time
[*] Trains will now depart at their correct scheduled time after loading
[/list]

More fixes are scheduled for the following days.

If you stumble across any problem with the game, make sure to report it in the Steam Community section!

Thanks to all of you for playing this game! I really appreciate it!

~ Shioyama

notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.content:
Thanks to those who submitted feedback and bug reports!

This update addresses the following issues:
[list]
[*] Acquisition of developed plots was too expensive → prices are now lower for developed plots
[*] Fixed staff quitting mid-shift when using exit-only or entrance-only ticket gates
[*] Fixed passengers getting stuck in front of toilets. Also, toilet processing time now works correctly, so passengers take some time to complete their "business".
[*] Queue positions now get updated when moving equipment
[*] Longer trains will now be used if demand is high enough
[/list]

There are some other minor issues that I will address in the following days.

If you stumble across any problem with the game, make sure to report it in the Steam Community section!

Thanks to all of you for playing this game! I really appreciate it!

~ Shioyama
